cloud.canCreateCloudCategory: Allows creating a cloud category. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canGetCloudCategory: Allows viewing a cloud category. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canDeleteCloudCategory: Allows deleting a cloud category. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canGetCloudCategoryList: Allows viewing cloud category list. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canUpdateCloudCategory: Allows updating a cloud category. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canCreateUserGroupFile: Allows creating a file. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canGetFileListForUser: Allows viewing file list for user. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canGetFile: Allows viewing a file. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canDeleteFile: Allows deleting a file. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canViewCloudFeature: Allows seeing the Cloud section in the app's navigation.
cloud.canCreatePublicFile: Allows creating a file that is visible to everyone, not just its creator. Found in the Cloud area.
cloud.canGetShareRecipientList: Allows listing the users a file can be sent to; the scope decides whom (own: nobody, tenant: the same tenant, all: everyone). Found in the Cloud area.
